physics.raw_states: 61 integration states: explicit initialized state0 plus60postintegration states
physics.contact_time_semantics: After step k, solved contact/frame/force describe preintegration solver_t=(k-1)*.005; qpos/qvel/time are postintegration state_t=k*.005. Record both and do not refresh contacts with an extra forward.
physics.startup_contacts: Separate startup_forward sample at0, not counted as a stepped response
physics.capacity: Read sticky wp_data.overflow exactly once after step60; never clear/reset; require one-world bitmask0 and all recorded nacon/nefc strictly below allocatedcapacity
physics.force_time_semantics: actuator_force_native and contactforce both belong to just-completed preintegration solver; rawstates explicitly record forcephase/force_solver_time/prestateindex, solver samples prestate_index=k-1/poststate_index=k. startup forward separate.

reporting: Retain complete60steps for quality failures. Stop only engineering hardexception/nonfinite/softdeadline; preserve partial rawdata and mark incomplete/UNKNOWN rather than fail physical gates on unrun samples. If capacityoverflow/countgate fails despite60complete, preservecomplete raw but hold verdictUNKNOWN/physics_inference_qualified=false; capacityOK uses the fixed qualitygates. C2frame0clampedcomponents0 is recorded; no filter treatment effect is inferred.
